title: Russian 'Double-Tap' Drone Strike on Kryvyi Rih Shopping Mall Kills at Least 16, Injures 130+
detail: Russia struck the Solnechnaya Galereya shopping mall in Kryvyi Rih — President Zelensky's hometown in Dnipropetrovsk region — with multiple drones on the afternoon of August 21 in what Ukrainian officials called a 'double-tap' attack: a second drone hit the same building roughly 30 minutes after the first strike, as firefighters and medics were already working the scene. At least 16 people were killed and 130 injured, including 23 children; 61 people were hospitalized, 23 in serious condition, and 9 people — including 2 children — remained missing as rescuers dug through the wreckage overnight. Zelensky said it is important 'that we have everything to protect life' and 'that the world does not remain silent about all this,' calling such attacks 'nothing less than terrorist acts.'

media.caption: Rescuers work at the Solnechnaya Galereya shopping mall in Kryvyi Rih after Russia's double-tap drone strike

title: Russian Shahed Strike on Mykolaiv Region's Tokarivka Kills 4, Including 3 Children
detail: A Russian Shahed-type drone struck a building housing a store, post office, and pharmacy in Tokarivka, in the Veselynivka community of Mykolaiv region, on the evening of August 21, killing 4 people — two 11-year-old boys, a 13-year-old boy, and a 30-year-old man — and injuring a 36-year-old woman, according to Interior Minister Ivan Vyhivskyi. Fire engulfed the store, pharmacy, and post office. A day of mourning was declared in Mykolaiv Oblast for the victims.

media.caption: Aftermath of the Russian Shahed strike on Tokarivka, Mykolaiv region

title: Russia Says It's Open to 'New Ideas' on Ending War, But Only on Putin's Terms
detail: Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergey Ryabkov said Moscow is 'ready to listen to any reasonable proposals and ideas that are in line with the goals set by the Russian president,' as US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner prepared renewed shuttle diplomacy between Kyiv and Moscow. Putin's stated preconditions remain unchanged: Ukraine must cede the entirety of the eastern Donbas region, demilitarize, and pledge never to seek NATO membership before any ceasefire. The statement came as Zelensky said Ukraine and its partners had developed a joint pressure plan against Putin and reiterated Kyiv is 'ready for any format of negotiations capable of bringing about a just and lasting peace.'
